note: Recorded result of the full Lean gate, written by hand from an actual run. generate_assurance_report.py reads it and never runs the gate itself (~12 min). Staleness is keyed on the SHA-256 of the on-disk sources in 05_lean_formalization/ (.lean files, lakefile, lean-toolchain, verify_all_proofs.sh): any edit to a .lean file, the lakefile, or the gate script invalidates the record. The commit field records where it was run; it is not the staleness key, because a commit touching only assurance docs cannot invalidate a Lean run.
mathlib_cache: pre-existing in .lake/packages (not a cold fetch; see assurance/O6.json)
certifies: elaboration, absence of sorry, and a standard axiom footprint {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}
does_not_certify: that assumptions carried as typeclass or structure fields are physically justified (THEORY_ASSUMPTION_AUDIT.md), nor cold-clone reproducibility (O6)
